title: Admission Open House
description: Tour our campus, meet our teachers, and learn about our Montessori-inspired curriculum. Light refreshments will be served for families.
location: Kaylan Preschool Main Campus, Electronic City

title: Annual Sports Day
description: A morning full of races, relays, and team games for all our little athletes. Parents are welcome to cheer from the sidelines!

title: Parent-Teacher Meet
description: One-on-one conversations with your child's teacher about progress, milestones, and how to support learning at home.

title: Diwali Celebration
description: Diyas, rangoli, sweets, and a festive performance by our students to celebrate the festival of lights together as one big Kaylan family.
